Ice formations like knives are scattered around here, near invisible and incredibly sharp
1,A garden of bizarre mutant carnivorous plants

1,A mountain of gold and diamonds
1,A moving city, built on the back of a giant animal

1,A rickety old bridge made of bones. Underneath the bridge, crocodiles wait to snap up prey who fall into the water

1,A snow-covered forest, with ever-burning churches and wolves than eat distance

1,A stairway which stands in the middle of nowhere that extends hundreds of feet up and abruptly ends

1,A stretch of beach with hundreds of huge nautilus and conch shells occupied by local [Animal.fantasyHumanoid]s

1,A subterranean garden of fungi of various types

1,A village of the undead where the sun never rises

1,What appears to be tall grass ([Dice.2d6]′) but is actually carnivorous anemone-like tentacles

1,Bleeding rocks

1,Bonsai mountains

1,A desert of razor sharp glass

1,An enormous [Utility.Flower]

1,A garden of [Utility.Flower]s the size of trees

1,A megasussurus

1,A mushroom field
1,Narrow (a metre across) but near mountain height rock formations

1,A nightmare lake

1,Peaceful, white sandy beaches … with giant carnivorous clams burrowed just below the surface that snap up and consume the unwary

Moss, lichen and small shrubs grow on the plain, and slender trees grow in the bottom of the ravine (which is more fertile due to pooling water and rotting trapped animals). 1,Tall grass ([Dice.2d6]′)
1,Terrible sucking mud, with trapped [Animal.fantasyLand]

1,The bottom of the ocean. There’s no water but the fish don’t notice, swimming around and leering at you in the air

1,The corpse of a titanic worm, mummified by salt and reaching hundreds of feet above the ground
1,The fossilized remains of a dead god, lying recumbent over the landscape, turned to a crystalline material by time
1,The land is like molten wax, dripped and stretched straight up. It is made of [Utility.Ornamental Stones] and [Utility.Ornamental Stones], [Color.dark] with [Color.hues] hints

1,What appears to be a particularly placid, misty mountain pool is actually a large mirror of unknown function and origin
1,A wheeled abandoned theater
1,Wind-sculped rock formations, stones twisted into arabesques
